seo.meta_description: PerfectServe is a Best in KLAS clinical communication platform for hospitals. Secure messaging, pager replacement, physician scheduling. 500+ hospitals.

faqs.a: Enterprise clinical communication platform for hospitals and health systems. Replaces pagers with HIPAA-compliant secure messaging, provides on-call scheduling, answering service, and EMR integration. Founded 1997, serves 500+ hospitals and 30,000+ practices.

faqs.q: What makes PerfectServe different from other messaging apps?
faqs.a: Dynamic Intelligent Routing—their proprietary technology that automatically identifies and connects messages to the right care team member based on the clinical situation, schedule, and role. Not just a messaging app; it's a workflow system.
Yes. Best in KLAS 2025 and 2026 for both Clinical Communications (Ambulatory/Post-Acute) and Physician Scheduling (Lightning Bolt). Six Best in KLAS awards total for clinical communication.
Yes. 250+ healthcare integrations including major EHR systems. Patient-centric messaging allows tracking all messages against a patient with two-way EMR synchronization.
